items.name: Empacer
items.tagline: The voice-first assistant for small business owners
items.description: Most small business owners face the same problem when trying to use AI tools: they don't have time for re-explaining their business in every chat. Empacer is designed to skip this part. Three questions at setup, then spoken requests become a ready plan and finished work: customer replies, social posts, invoices and more. Nothing is sent without the owner's approval.

items.name: Scape
items.tagline: An intelligent email inbox that works for you
items.description: Imagine opening your inbox and finding everything already organized, with replies ready to review. Scape is an intelligent email client that prioritizes messages, prepares contextual drafts, and helps track conversations and follow-ups. It understands your work across emails, meetings, calendars, and attachments, so you can spend less time managing communication and more time moving work forward.

items.name: Notch Metrics
items.tagline: Use claude code to build analytics widgets for your notch
items.description: Revenue, MRR and subscribers from Stripe, Polar, Paddle, Dodo Payments and more, in the MacBook notch.

items.name: Floot in ChatGPT
items.tagline: Build and publish real apps without leaving ChatGPT
items.description: Floot is now a native app in your ChatGPT sidebar. Describe what you want, watch it build in a live preview inside the chat, and publish it with a real link. Database, logins and hosting are built in, and the AI runs on your ChatGPT plan.

items.name: Gologin Cloud Browser
items.tagline: Cloud browser for AI agents and tough sites
items.description: Gologin Cloud Browser gives AI agents and scrapers real Chromium browsers that stay logged in. Persistent sessions survive across runs, so there’s no re-auth or lost state. Built-in stealth and anti-bot protection, plus proxies in 150+ countries. Fully serverless, it scales to thousands of browsers and works with Playwright and Puppeteer via WebSocket. Built by the GoLogin team: 7 years’ expertise, SOC 2 Type II, 99.9% SLA. Plans from $4.50/mo.

items.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
items.tagline: Google's next frontier model
items.description: Gemini 4 Carbon is our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.

items.name: TopAgent
items.tagline: Drive B2B event attendance with an AI agent
items.description: Fill your next B2B conference, summit, or workshop with SMS invitations and relevant follow-ups. Give TopAgent your opted-in audience, event details, registration link, and deadline. It prepares the campaign, monitors delivery, clicks, and replies, and returns with follow-ups ready for your approval.

items.name: Radar
items.tagline: You don't need an AI SRE. Give your agent Radar.
items.description: Your agent knows Kubernetes. It doesn't know your cluster. Radar (open-source) gives it context over MCP: ranked issues, a change timeline, logs and owners in one view. New: click Investigate on a failing workload. Claude Code, Codex or Cursor finds the root cause, read-only, with evidence for each claim. In our benchmark of 50 live faults across six tools, Radar found the most root causes. Radar Cloud investigates every alert and posts findings to Slack.

items.name: IFTTT.ai
items.tagline: The easiest way to automate anything
items.description: IFTTT is now IFTTT.ai, and every plan now includes our core features and all 1,000+ services, from multiple actions and filters to queries and Webhooks. Pricing is credit-based, and you can build unlimited Applets for free. AI got an upgrade too. AI Agent watches web pages for price changes or new listings, AI Action assist writes each action based on its trigger, and AI queries run on better models. Or describe an automation in IFTTT Chat and it builds the Applet for you.

items.name: Confetti
items.tagline: Easiest way to build hardware gadgets using plain English
items.description: Making hardware used to take weeks of learning CAD, sourcing compatible parts, and writing firmware. With Confetti, it starts with a conversation. Create and edit designs, find components, and order printed parts straight to your doorstep. Start from scratch or remix a community project to make it your own.

items.name: Intrascope 2.0
items.tagline: New AI agent, 1,650+ apps, Skills and smart model routing
items.description: What's different: ChatGPT and Claude lock you into one vendor. Intrascope 2.0 gives your team 120+ models (GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen) plus an AI agent that works in 1,650+ apps like Gmail, Slack, Drive and Notion. The company stays in control: admins approve apps and models, set budgets per team, project and person, and see every token and dollar. New in 2.0: agent, connectors, Skills, Auto routing, full redesign. Private and on-prem deployments for enterprise.

items.name: Viggle JST-2
items.tagline: JST-2: 3D scenes, characters and motion from one model
items.description: JST-2 is Viggle’s physics-native world foundation model for generating 3D scenes, characters and full-body motion in one shared world. Scenes take about one second, characters come from one image or text with motion built in, and motion comes from text or video. Try it free in the PINOC browser app, or use the API or MCP with agents like Claude Code. Benchmarks are Viggle’s own blind human tests.

items.name: JIMMY
items.tagline: JIMMY is an AI agent that runs on your PC
items.description: JIMMY runs on your Windows PC and listens to your WhatsApp self-chat. Text "send the resume in Downloads to Rahul" or "screenshot" and it does the task, asks before sending anything, and replies. Scheduled tasks, custom commands, /stop and an undo log included.

items.name: Voxel51 Multimodal
items.tagline: Better data. Smarter robots. Repeat.
items.description: The real world is messy. Robots encounter unexpected situations and behave in ways you never anticipated. But every failure is a chance to teach your robot something new. The hard part? Sifting through hours of video and sensor data to figure out why your robot failed. Voxel51 is an end-to-end multimodal data platform that accelerates robot learning. Find the failures that matter, understand why they happened, and fill gaps in your training data to improve models faster. Try Voxel51 for free.

items.name: Suno MCP
items.tagline: The music layerfor your AI stack
items.description: MCP stands for Model Context Protocol, an open standard that lets AI assistants work with other apps. The Suno MCP connects your Suno account to the AI assistants you already use, like ChatGPT and Claude. Once it’s connected, you can ask your assistant to make a song, extend it, cover it, and more, right in the conversation you’re already having! Your assistant can use everything you’ve already discussed (lyrics, a project, a video plan) so you don’t have to re-explain your idea.

items.name: Smart Jelly
items.tagline: Your everyday AI tools and memory in one Mac app.
items.description: One app for dictation, live meeting help, Pre meeting notes, Notetaker, Track open loops and agents, all sharing one memory of you. No need to pay for five AI tools that each start from zero. Every feature knows your work and gets smarter as you use it.

items.name: AutoShelf 2.6
items.tagline: Automate any folder on your Mac with if-this-then-that rules
items.description: AutoShelf is a Mac app that automatically files, renames, tags, converts, and sorts new files in folders like Downloads and Desktop, based on rules you set once. New: sort into subfolders built from tokens like %kind% and %date%, unarchive, Finder color labels, and rules that cover all or selected subfolders. Free with 1 rule, or $19.99 one-time for unlimited rules ($29.99 from Nov 25). Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later.

items.name: StoreLocale
items.tagline: Translate app UI in App Store & Google Play screenshots
items.description: Localize the UI inside App Store and Google Play screenshots. StoreLocale detects text, translates it into 32 languages, and repaints it in place while keeping the layout intact. Review results in the editor, then export PNGs grouped by store, language, and size. The editor is free; use your own Gemini or OpenRouter API key, or buy one-time credits for AI image generation.

items.name: ChatInbox
items.tagline: Email that groups your inbox by contact
items.description: ChatInbox rebuilds the inbox around people instead of time. Every customer, vendor or friend becomes one conversation: full history, every file, whose turn it is. That is CRM-grade context inside your mailbox, across Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP account, with newsletters and receipts filed into Feeds automatically. Three years of iteration, native on Mac, iPhone and iPad. Apple Intelligence powers drafting, summaries and triage on-device, so your mail never leaves your devices.

items.name: Kin
items.tagline: The AI labs want to own you. Make them answer to you.
items.description: Let your AIs run free. Kin keeps them in check. Connect GitHub, Gmail or Stripe once, add Kin to ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor, and give each action a rule: Allow, Ask me or Block. Ask me waits for your OK on the web or your phone.
